quests.name: Lilara's Lost Kitty
quests.offer:
My kitty! She ran off over the hill, east of here. Oh, she's so small and helpless.
Will you find her?
quests.started: Over the hill, to the east. Hurry!

steps.journal: Look for Lilara's kitty over the hill east of her.

events.text: That is no kitty: it is a bear! And two wolves have set on it.

steps.journal: Save the kitty: kill the two wolves.

steps.says: The bear purrs, of all things, and lumbers off home.

steps.journal: Tell Lilara her kitty is on her way home.
steps.says: She came home! You found my kitty! Here, for your trouble.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/HuntAndGather/lilara-and-skerg.json (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Low levels only: 5 to 20, ours (the guide gives no figures). 100k experience and 200 tunar are the guide's; repeatable. The guide's Cara Village is CLIENT's Kara Village.

quests.name: A Pretty Necklace
quests.offer:
Skerg wants pretty necklace. Pretty! You go Dead Hills. Skerg needs two zombie sinew, two rusty needle.
You bring?

steps.journal: Kill zombies in the Dead Hills for two zombie sinews.
Kill spiders in the Dead Hills for two rusty needles.
Bring Skerg two zombie sinews and two rusty needles on the road north of Freeport.
steps.says: Pretty! Skerg make. You take one. Skerg make more.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/HuntAndGather/lilara-and-skerg.json (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). High levels only: from 50, ours. The drops' chance is ours; the guide's necklace is a low-value stackable.
